coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 7 of 11 ground-truth items (64%): all three prompting methods, all three tasks, and fixed random seeds.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies alternative multi-GPU A100/H100 80GB hardware rather than NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, uses three repetitions per instance rather than ten runs per task, and does not establish the required shared framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Measures latency in milliseconds and uses natural-log transformation for testing rather than specifying base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected general increase in BoT inference time relative to single-query methods nor the task-specific timing results, including BoT being faster than PAL on Game of 24.
